## Validation

- [ ] Formatting, clippy, and tests pass
- [ ] Compatibility fixture or regression test added
- [ ] Linux exercised
- [ ] macOS arm64 exercised or not applicable
- [ ] macOS Intel exercised or not applicable
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No proprietary commands, transcripts, environment values, or endpoint logs included
- [ ] New dependencies are justified and pass advisory/license checks
- [ ] Runtime privileges, network access, and persisted data are unchanged or explicitly documented
